name: MCSManager-Daemon
description: MCSManager (MCSM) Daemon - the backend component that manages and runs your game server instances. Communicates with the MCSManager Web UI panel to launch, stop, and monitor servers. NOTE: This is the Daemon component. You must also run the MCSManager-Web container. After installation, open the Web UI, go to Nodes, set a name for the Node, and set the Daemon IP to YOUR_Unraid_IP

paths.name: Daemon Data
paths.description: Stores daemon data including server instance files.

paths.name: Docker Socket
paths.description: Allows MCSManager Daemon to manage Docker containers for game servers.

ports.name: Daemon Port
ports.description: Port used for communication between the Daemon and the Web UI panel.

ports.name: Minecraft Port Range
ports.description: Port range for Minecraft server instances. Expand this range if you plan to run more than 10 servers.

ports.name: Minecraft Port Range UDP
ports.description: UDP port range for Minecraft Bedrock server instances.

ports.name: Web Map Port
ports.description: Optional port or port range for web map viewing (Bluemap, Dynmap) (eg. 8100, 8123)

variables.name: Docker Workspace Path
variables.description: Path where MCSManager stores game server instance data. Must match the Daemon Data path.
